svg.title: How the names of the engines are checked
svg.desc: A pull request that changes the step of an engine, such as an update of Renovate, or one that changes what the check reads, and a run every week start the job engine contracts of the Action test. It holds no secret, and its block lets through GitHub and npm's registry alone. It reads the action.yml of each engine's action at the commit that the workflows pin, and every input that a step passes and every output that a job reads must be there. It installs each engine's command line at its pinned version, as analyze does, and every flag of its step must be in its help, with its value, and every key of the Gemini CLI's settings in the schema of that version. Then each runs without a key, in a folder like that of analyze, and must stop at the missing key alone, with its settings taken. A renamed input, flag or key fails the check, which names it, before a release brings the new version to every repository.
